arxiv-2301-11789.title: A radiation and propagation problem for a Helmholtz equation with a compactly supported nonlinearity
arxiv-2301-11789.creator: Lutz Angermann
arxiv-2301-11789.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Lutz Angermann. The present work describes some extensions of an approach, originally developed by V.V. Yatsyk and the author, for the theoretical and numerical analysis of scattering and radiation effects on infinite plates with cubically polarized layers.

arxiv-2305-04844.title: SR+Codec: a Benchmark of Super-Resolution for Video Compression Bitrate Reduction
arxiv-2305-04844.creator: Evgeney Bogatyrev, Ivan Molodetskikh, Dmitriy Vatolin
arxiv-2305-04844.description: Abstract In recent years, there has been significant interest in Super-Resolution (SR), which focuses on generating a high-resolution image from a low-resolution input. Deep learning-based methods for super-resolution have been particularly popular and have shown impressive results on various benchmarks. However, research indicates that these methods may not perform as well on strongly compressed videos.

arxiv-2308-06256.title: Single crystal synthesis, structure, and magnetism of Pb 10-x Cu x (PO 4 ) 6 O
arxiv-2308-06256.creator: P. Puphal*, M. Y. P. Akbar, M. Hepting, E. Goering, M. Isobe, A. A. Nugroho, B. Keimer
arxiv-2308-06256.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by P. Puphal*, M. Y. P. Akbar, M. Hepting, E. Goering, M. Isobe, A. A. Nugroho, B. Keimer. The recent claim of superconductivity above room temperature in Pb 10-x Cu x (PO 4 ) 6 O with 0.9 < x x < 1 (referred to as LK-99) has sparked considerable interest. To minimize the influence of structural defects and impurity phases on the physical properties, we have synthesized phase-pure single crystals with a copper doping level of x ∼ 1 x\sim 1 .

arxiv-2407-02472.title: ValueScope : Unveiling Implicit Norms and Values via Return Potential Model of Social Interactions
arxiv-2407-02472.creator: Chan Young Park Shuyue Stella Li Hayoung Jung, Svitlana Volkova Tanushree Mitra David Jurgens Yulia Tsvetkov
arxiv-2407-02472.description: Abstract This study introduces ValueScope , a framework leveraging language models to quantify social norms and values within online communities, grounded in social science perspectives on normative structures. We employ ValueScope to dissect and analyze linguistic and stylistic expressions across 13 Reddit communities categorized under gender, politics, science, and finance.

arxiv-2508-12938.title: Modified security analysis of device-independent quantum key distribution with random key basis
arxiv-2508-12938.creator: Sawan Bhattacharyya, Turbasu Chatterjee, Pankaj Agrawal, Prasenjit Deb
arxiv-2508-12938.description: Abstract Security analysis is a critical part in any cryptographic protocol, may it be classical or quantum. Without security analysis, one cannot ensure the secrecy of the distributed keys. To perform a conclusive security analysis, it is very often necessary to frame the problem as an optimization problem. However, solving such optimization problems is quite challenging.

arxiv-2509-18915.title: Covering rings by proper ideals
arxiv-2509-18915.creator: Malcolm Hoong Wai Chen, Eric Swartz, Nicholas J. Werner
arxiv-2509-18915.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Malcolm Hoong Wai Chen, Eric Swartz, Nicholas J. Werner. Let R R be an associative (not necessarily commutative or unital) ring. A cover by left ideals of R R is a collection of proper left ideals whose set-theoretic union equals R R .

arxiv-2601-02601.title: State of the Quantum Software Engineering Ecosystem
arxiv-2601-02601.creator: Nazanin Siavash, Armin Moin
arxiv-2601-02601.description: Abstract . We study the current state of the Quantum Software Engineering (QSE) ecosystem, focusing on the achievements, activities, and engagements from academia and industry, with a special focus on successful entrepreneurial endeavors in this arena. Our research methodology is a novel one, featuring the state-of-the-art in Artificial Intelligence (AI), namely Large Language Models (LLMs), especially Generative Pretrained Transformers (GPT).

pmc-10560223.title: The impact of non-synonymous mutations on miRNA binding sites within the SARS-CoV-2 NSP3 and NSP4 genes
pmc-10560223.creator: S M Ali Hosseini Rad, Dhammika Leshan Wannigama, Nattiya Hirankarn, Alexander D McLellan
pmc-10560223.description: Non-synonymous mutations in the SARS-CoV-2 spike region affect cell entry, tropism, and immune evasion, while frequent synonymous mutations may modify viral fitness. Host microRNAs, a type of non-coding RNA, play a crucial role in the viral life cycle, influencing viral replication and the host immune response directly or indirectly.

pmc-10642363.title: Critical re-examination of known purported fossil Bombycoidea (Lepidoptera)
pmc-10642363.creator: Maria Heikkilä, Joël Minet, Andreas Zwick, Anna Hundsdoerfer, Rodolphe Rougerie, Ian J. Kitching
pmc-10642363.description: We critically re-examine 17 records of fossils currently assigned to the lepidopteran superfamily Bombycoidea, which includes the silk moths, emperor moths and hawk moths. These records include subfossils, compression and impression fossils, permineralizations and ichnofossils. We assess whether observable morphological features warrant their confident assignment to the superfamily.

pmc-10670704.title: From Non-Alcoholic Steatohepatitis (NASH) to Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC): Epidemiology, Incidence, Predictions, Risk Factors, and Prevention
pmc-10670704.creator: Benedetta Maria Motta, Mario Masarone, Pietro Torre, Marcello Persico
pmc-10670704.description: Simple SummaryNon-alcoholic fatty liver disease affects up to a quarter of the adult population in many developed and developing countries. This disease has become the fastest-growing cause of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) in industrialized countries. The annual incidence of hepatocarcinoma varies between patients with cirrhosis and noncirrhotic patients.

pmc-10845067.title: Oxford Nanopore Technology and its Application in Liquid Biopsies
pmc-10845067.creator: Mariya Levkova, Trifon Chervenkov, Lyudmila Angelova, Deyan Dzenkov
pmc-10845067.description: Advanced medical technologies are transforming the future of healthcare, in particular, the screening and detection of molecular-genetic changes in patients suspected of having a neoplasm. They are based on the assumption that neoplasms release small amounts of various neoplasm-specific molecules, such as tumor DNA, called circulating DNA (cirDNA), into the extracellular space and subsequently into the blood.

pmc-12367569.title: Evaluating educational effectiveness of three-dimensional (3D)-printed training models and custom-made fibula model for osteotomy and flap inset training in head and neck reconstruction
pmc-12367569.creator: Dharmik Gondalia, Mohit Parakh, Kunal Mokhale, Vineet Kumar, Ameya Bindu, Mayur Mantri, Saumya Mathews, Dushyant Jaiswal, Akshay Bhavke, Vinay Kant Shankhdhar
pmc-12367569.description: BackgroundReconstructive surgery following head and neck cancer resection is inherently complex and technically demanding. Procedures such as osteotomy and flap inset involve a steep learning curve, yet opportunities for hands-on training are increasingly limited. Physical simulation using cost-effective, anatomically realistic models offers a promising solution.

pmc-12509651.title: 33: fusion derived oncogenic programs shape the immune landscape in translocation renal cell carcinoma
pmc-12509651.creator: Prathyusha Konda, Cary Weiss, Yantong Cui, Jinyu Wang, Sayed Matar, Yasmin Nabil Laimon, Aseman Sheshdeh, Riva Deodhar, Sabrina Camp, Jack Horst, Jonathan Hecht, David Einstein, Anwesha Nag, Aaron Thorner, Eliezer Van Allen, Cheng-Zhong Zhang, Sabina Signoretti, Toni Choueri, Srinivas Viswanathan
pmc-12509651.description: BackgroundRenal cell carcinoma (RCC) comprises a heterogeneous group of cancers with diverse molecular drivers and clinical behaviors. Despite this diversity, the majority of RCC cases are treated using therapeutic strategies developed for the most common subtype, clear cell RCC (ccRCC), due to limited understanding of subtype-specific biology.

pmc-13086726.title: Dewatering assessment of sewage sludge: a remaining challenge
pmc-13086726.creator: Javier Pavez-Jara, Leon Korving, David Jeison, Merle K de Kreuk
pmc-13086726.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Improved sewage sludge dewaterability saves costs in biosolids transport and disposal, making reliable dewaterability assessment essential for both research and full-scale process evaluation. However, laboratory-based indexes commonly used to predict dewatering performance often show limited correspondence with full-scale results. Nonetheless, indexes such as capillary suction time (CST), sedimentation and centrifugation methods, specific resistance to filtration (SRF), and mixed dead-end techniques show biases when trying to resemble full-scale results.

pmc-13220580.title: Exploring the experiences and needs in everyday life of spouse carers of persons with dementia
pmc-13220580.creator: Marcus F Johansson, Lena Marmstål Hammar, Lena Dahlberg, Kevin McKee, Chirstine Williams, Martina Summer Meranius
pmc-13220580.description: PurposeSpouses of persons with dementia often take on caring responsibilities that can be overwhelming and negatively affect their well-being. To support the development of effective services and promote carer well-being, we aim to describe carer experiences and needs in everyday life.MethodsSemi-structured phone interviews were conducted with a convenience sample of 24 spouses caring for a partner with dementia in Sweden.
